name: Day One of My New Life

passive.name: At This Very Moment
passive.description: Increases the wearer's DEF by {p1}%. After entering battle, increases All-Type RES of all allies by {p2}%. Abilities of the same type cannot stack.

lore: "So happy I got to see Pom-Pom in new clothes today! I like it~" "Today's my birthday! I'm still as cute as ever." "Today, I finally finally finally have a junior! Isn't that right, {NICKNAME}?" We click the shutter many times without thinking. Do we do that to capture the happiness at that moment? Or to capture ourselves at that moment?
